turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone. Owen found out on his phone in the middle of class.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You didn't answer my question. Who decided, and was Owen heard before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent from a machine is a guess, and even the company that sells these says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. What else do you have, or is that it?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Okay, I'm writing that down. Fourteen of these tools were tested last year and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, so unless you have something with Owen's name and a date on it, I want the zero withdrawn today.
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." So you decided first and asked questions later, and nobody called me, which your own procedure, 4.2, says comes before any mark is entered. I'll be in the principal's office when we're done here unless you give me a reason not to be.
I hope you understand my position.
Your position is a number from a machine and a zero that went in before anyone spoke to Owen or to me. Don't manage me, Hale. Is there a document or not?
